ui_bugs.issue: route-delete confirmation dialog is triggered but the DELETE API call is never executed on web preview. After tapping route-delete-{id} and accepting the browser confirm dialog (page.on('dialog') accept), the route remains in the list and GET /api/fixed-routes still returns it. Root cause: React-Native-Web Alert.alert with multi-button config does not always propagate the destructive button's onPress callback in this Metro/RN-Web version. The toggle (Switch) works fine because it is a direct handler. Backend DELETE endpoint works correctly (verified via direct API call: 200). Fix suggestion: replace Alert.alert with a cross-platform ConfirmDialog component or use Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm(...) : Alert.alert(...) fallback.

action_items: Replace Alert.alert-based delete confirmation in /app/frontend/src/components/admin/CatalogAdmin.tsx (line 49, remove()) with a web-compatible flow, e.g. `if (Platform.OS === 'web') { if (!window.confirm(`Supprimer « ${r.name} » ?`)) return; await apiFetch(...); load(); } else { Alert.alert(...) }`. This restores parity with the Toggle switch which already works on web.
Optional: expose SUPPORT_WHATSAPP / SUPPORT_EMAIL / SUPPORT_PHONE placeholders in /app/backend/.env once real values are known; UI already shows the intended 'support-empty' fallback.

rca_of_issue: ROUTE-DELETE ON WEB: CatalogAdmin.remove() uses `Alert.alert('Supprimer', ..., [{text:'Annuler',style:'cancel'}, {text:'Supprimer',style:'destructive',onPress: async () => { await apiFetch(..., {method:'DELETE'}, token); load(); }}])`. In react-native-web, the Alert polyfill for multi-button setups is unreliable (it silently no-ops or maps to a single confirm without wiring the destructive button's onPress). The browser 'dialog' event was accepted in the Playwright run but the destructive onPress never executed – no network request was seen and the DB row remained. Mitigation: guard on Platform.OS === 'web' with window.confirm, keeping Alert.alert for native, or introduce a small cross-platform ConfirmModal component (aligns with existing SheetModal pattern).
